item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00046","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C12","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.79,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 plausibly supplied a material template for allocating statutory powers vested in the President among designated officials and agencies. Both directives organize the delegation by numbered provisions, identify the recipients and statutory sections, assign different portions of the statutory authority to different administrators, and use closely related formulations concerning presidential “functions,” “powers,” “authority,” and “discretion.” C12 is also strongly analogous but contains only a single, simpler blanket delegation. C09 uses comparable statutory delegation machinery but is narrower and less structurally similar.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Commerce shall perform and exercise the functions, duties, powers, authority, and discretion ... vested in the President by sections 3, 4, 18(c), and 18(d)","parent_excerpt":"The authority ... provided for in section 2 of the said joint resolution ... is delegated severally to the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of Commerce, and the Director ... as provided in paragraphs 2, 3, 4, and 5","explanation":"Both begin by delegating presidential statutory authority to identified officials and then distribute its exercise through numbered provisions."},{"child_excerpt":"The Reconstruction Finance Corporation shall perform and exercise the functions vested in the President by, or designated in, sections 5(c), 5(e), 6, 7, 8, 11(a), and 18(f)","parent_excerpt":"The authority delegated to the Secretary of Commerce by paragraph 1 hereof shall be exercised by him with respect to priority, allocation, and inventory control of scarce commodities","explanation":"Each assigns a distinct subset of the statutory program to a particular agency or official, rather than making an undifferentiated delegation."},{"child_excerpt":"shall ... perform and exercise the functions of the President ... under sections 10 and 12 of the said Act","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of Commerce is hereby authorized to continue exercising the powers, authority, and discretion conferred upon the President by section 6 ... and the powers, authority, and discretion vested in the President by section 3 of the joint resolution","explanation":"The repeated formulation tying an administrator’s exercise of authority directly to enumerated statutory powers of the President provides concrete shared drafting language and machinery."}]}
